action.message:
Validation complete. The SPARK Workflow installation is **operational and complete** per the supplied guide.

## Verification performed

**Environment / method** — Confirmed the documented Docker Compose + Process Compose flow at `/workspace` (commit `0cd030a`). `git status` shows only the documented workaround file `docker-compose.override.yaml` untracked; repo otherwise clean.

**Prerequisites** — uv 0.12.23, Python 3.13.16 (`/workspace/.venv`), Process Compose v1.122.0, Node.js v24.11.1, pnpm 10.30.2, all present at expected versions.

**Infrastructure (Docker Compose)** — 11/11 containers up; PostgreSQL, Keycloak, MinIO, Temporal healthy. MinIO buckets `dms-local`, `quarantine-bucket`, `temporal-payloads` exist. Temporal `default` namespace registered with active workflow+activity pollers on `fvp-task-queue`. SpiceDB reports `status: SERVING`.

**Application services (Process Compose)** — API `http://localhost:8080/processes`: 38 total, 33 Running + 5 seed jobs Completed (exit 0), 0 failures. All 12 readiness-probed services report `Ready`; 16 backend `/healthz` endpoints return HTTP 200.

**End-to-end behavior** — Full browser OIDC login flow simulated: `GET /app/` → 302 to Keycloak → credential POST → `/oauth2/callback` → `/app/` returned the `SPARK Workflow` app HTML. Authenticated API call through oauth2-proxy (`:3000/pls/v1/project-statuses`) returned 200 with seeded data. Core workflow step executed: `POST /pls/v1/projects` created a Verfahren (HTTP 201), retrievable via `GET /projects`. FCS template endpoints return seeded categories/document-types; agent-orchestration exposes `/workflows/formale-pruefung`.

**Seed data verified in Postgres (via API and SQL)** — project statuses (5) & types (1) served by API; FCS `template_category=3`, `template_document_type=24`; VAE `vae_template=1` + 159 nodes; law DB `norm=2187`, `documents=33`, `absatz=7255`; jura-db and begruendungen-db migrated.

## Limitations
External LLM (`localhost:4000`) and Docling (`localhost:5001`) are intentionally not part of the local stack (guide states the stack does not start an LLM provider), so a live `KI-Analyse` run could not be executed or validated end-to-end. The `examination` process shows 21 restarts but is currently Running/Ready with exit 0 (consistent with the noted one-time migration readiness retries).
